solution_summary: Raylu built its AI origination engine on Google Cloud and Gemini, closing the gap between investor conviction and deployed capital. Founded in 2022, Raylu is building the AI origination engine for private markets, replacing static tools and manual research with an always-on system designed for the speed of modern investing. The company identified a structural problem in private markets: investment teams were relying on static databases, spreadsheets, and manual research processes to compete in markets moving faster than their infrastructure. Raylu saw an opportunity to rebuild the origination process around AI. Its AI origination engine combines public information with proprietary firm data to map markets, prioritize relevant companies, identify emerging signals, and support earlier founder engagement.
